title: Manager sync brief - Meera Kapoor (prep)
content:
Purpose: quick 20m sync with report to align priorities, unblock, and close open action items. Focus areas: sprint commitments, oncall signal reduction, career next-steps.

Timebox: 20 minutes (5m check-in + 8m tactical + 5m career + 2m wrap-up)

Agenda draft (timeboxed):
- 0-5m: Quick personal/pulse check (mood, bandwidth) + highlights from last week
- 5-13m: Tactical: status on KV cache regression mitigations, canary rollout for v2.3, PR backlog that blocks staging deploy
- 13-18m: Growth: stretch project interest (profiling/quantization whitepaper), mentorship pairing, next role-readiness steps
- 18-20m: Action items, owners, due dates, and parking-lot items

Key context to bring:
- KV cache regression: observed 8% higher token latency on sequences >1024 after tok-prefetch change. Root cause narrowed to cache key mismatch in continuous-batching layer (see JIRA-ENG-842).
- Canary plan: small pool (4 GPUs) running v2.3 with prefix caching disabled. Rollout target: 1% traffic -> 10% over 24h if no regressions. Need sign-off and smoke-test checklist completed.
- Oncall noise: recurring alerts from nvrtc memory spikes during heavy batching at t=0200–0400 UTC. SRE suggested throttling background batch compaction jobs.
- PRs blocking: GH #3271 (scheduler backpressure fix) needs rebase and perf bench; blocker for staging deploy.

Talking points / prompts for the report:
- How confident are you in the v2.3 canary? Any remaining unknowns?
- Do you need additional support to get GH #3271 rebased this week? ETA?
- Bandwidth check: are you comfortable taking the profiling spike project as a 20% time allocation/quarter stretch?
- Career: what skills do you want to prioritize next quarter (infra perf, people management, roadmap influence)?

Concrete acceptance criteria I want to establish this meeting:
- Clear ETA for GH #3271 rebase (date + owner)
- Decision on whether to enable canary tomorrow morning (yes/no + prerequisites completed)
- One concrete growth goal for the quarter (with a 2-step plan)

Current metrics / evidence to reference (bring screenshots if possible):
- Median token latency (prod baseline): 42ms per token; post-change median: 45ms; 95th: from 120ms -> 140ms on long sequences
- PR lead time: average 3.8 days last sprint; #3271 currently 6 days and blocked on perf tests
- Oncall MTTR: median 28 minutes; incidents related to batching spikes account for 35% of alerts this month

Potential quick wins to offer:
- I can take the perf bench rebase tomorrow morning (2 hours) to unblock staging if you want to focus on the canary checklist.
- Schedule a focused 90-minute profiling pair session Wednesday afternoon (me + you + infra) to scope the quantization proof-of-concept.

Career/Growth draft items (to discuss):
- Short-term (this quarter): lead the canary rollout operational checklist and run post-mortem for any regressions (opportunity: product-facing visibility).
- Mid-term (next 6 months): owner of continuous-batching perf story (define goals, own metrics dashboard).
- Skill gaps: public speaking / exec sync; propose 1 internal demo to product in Q4.

Open blockers (to resolve in meeting):
- Blocker A: Need perf run approvals for GH #3271 (access + GPU quota).
- Blocker B: Unclear rollback plan for canary if 95th percentile increases by >10%; need explicit rollback steps assigned.

Draft action items (to convert into tickets during/after meeting):
- Meera: draft rollback procedure and add to canary checklist (due 2026-10-13)
- Report (Ravi): complete rebase and trigger perf bench for GH #3271 (target 2026-10-14)
- Meera & SRE: test throttling change for batch compaction in staging (target 2026-10-15)
- Meera: schedule profiling pairing session (invite sent by 2026-10-12)
- Report: pick one growth goal and 2 concrete steps, share by 2026-10-18

Parking lot / follow-ups (for next sync):
- Decide on longer-term quota plan for perf runs; finance involvement if needed.
- Mentorship match: identify mentor for infra perf (product/eng mix)

Notes to self (prep before meeting):
- Pull last 48h traces for token latency (prod + staging) and attach screenshot.
- Open GH #3271 and local perf logs; bring quick summary paragraph of what failed in prior bench.
- Draft 3-sentence ask for growth goal so the report can pick quickly.

Tone reminders: keep the meeting crisp, empower the report to pick the growth goal, be decisive on the canary prerequisites (we want to avoid wobble).

Quick meeting script (one-liner prompts):
- "Quick pulse — how's bandwidth this sprint? Anything blocking you besides GH #3271?"
- "For the canary, we can enable tomorrow if rollback steps are done — can you own drafting those?"
- "Which skill would you most like to develop next quarter — infra perf or product-facing communications?"

Last-minute checklist before starting call:
- Slack DM the report the links to JIRA/GH/perf screenshots
- Open the canary checklist doc (confluence.redwood/serving/runtime-canary-notes)
- Make sure screen-sharing works for the perf charts

End of prep. Will convert action items into short Linear tickets after the sync.
